notablePrerequisites: Thopter Squadron has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Repeat.
